title: Review gate
applies_to: a pull request on a shared platform repo
summary: Answer every Devin comment, then run the code review skill once and fix its blocker and major findings before the merge gate.
use_when: Changes to shared platform code: the orchestrator, fleet infrastructure and Ansible, Notify, Commander itself
Anything touching auth, permissions, secrets, PHI or data deletion
skip_when: A one-line config or version bump
Forge app changes: they ship through the Forge app release process, not a pull request, so use that workflow instead

steps.title: Answer every Devin comment (fix it or reply why not) and resolve its thread
Run ce-code-review once, fix its blocker and major findings, post the report
